name: Togami Akimori
source:
Tsukiyado High 3rd Year, Class 4.
It seems he's the student council president.

He's a frivolous person.
He seems to be the student council president, but I've never seen him work.
The head is warm and has a weak natural radio wave system.
He has his own aesthetic and is surrounded by baseless confidence.
Big and bold.
He doesn't care about the details. He loves children and birds.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/kaerubatake/char_togami.html]official website[/url].]
